close_reason: Fixed: added doc note to MalformedCertificate variant explaining why der::Error is intentionally not stored (no_std compat, stable API shape)
description: File: pkix-path/src/lib.rs. Both the original cert_name_constraints (line 1031) and the 4 new try_find_cert_ext call sites for PolicyMappings/PolicyConstraints/InhibitAnyPolicy use map_err(|_| Error::MalformedCertificate { index }) which discards the underlying der::Error. MalformedCertificate only carries an index, not the root cause. Add a doc comment at each call site explaining the discard is intentional (or use Error::Der if the schema supports it).
title: P3: map_err(|_|) discards der::Error in try_find_cert_ext call sites — 5 sites
